title: Compiling VGDL into Causal Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.05459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning and large language models often struggle to accurately capture the causal mechanics of game environments. Standard reinforcement learning agents tend to rely on spurious correlations, while large language models are prone to hallucinating game rules. Although causal reinforcement learning improves interpretability, there is currently no formal methodology to map complex game mechanics directly into causal models. To address this, we propose a deterministic framework that compiles games specified in the Video Game Description Language into Dynamic Structural Causal Models. Rather than inferring causal structures from gameplay traces or noisy large language models' outputs, our methodology directly translates game components, including sprite dynamics, interaction rules, and termination conditions, into explicit structural equations. translated_title: 将视频游戏描述语言（VGDL）编译为因果模型
translated_abstract: 强化学习和大语言模型往往难以准确捕捉游戏环境的因果机制。标准的强化学习智能体倾向于依赖虚假相关性，而大语言模型则容易对游戏规则产生幻觉。尽管因果强化学习提升了可解释性，但目前尚缺乏将复杂游戏机制直接映射到因果模型的形式化方法。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个确定性框架，将用视频游戏描述语言（VGDL）规范描述的游戏编译为动态结构因果模型。我们的方法不再从游戏过程轨迹或嘈杂的大语言模型输出中推断因果结构，而是直接将游戏组件——包括精灵动态、交互规则和终止条件——转换为显式的结构方程。每个游戏时间步（tick）都表示从时刻 t 的状态变量到 t+1 的因果转换。
tldr: 本文提出了一个确定性编译框架，将视频游戏描述语言（VGDL）描述的游戏直接编译为动态结构因果模型，把精灵动态、交互规则和终止条件等游戏组件转化为显式结构方程，从而避免了强化学习中的虚假相关性以及大语言模型的规则幻觉问题。
